results.title: Nuh district gets Animal Operation Theatre
results.description: Nuh district got its first state-of-the-art Animal Operation Theatre today, with Deputy Commissioner Akhil Pilani inaugurating the facility at the SPCA Infirmary in Shri Chetan Das Gau Samvardhan Sansthan, Sangail, in his capacity as SPCA chairman. The move is aimed at upgrading veterinary infrastructure under the Aspirational District programme, catering to the district’s livestock population [...]
